license: All rights reserved on this index. Each record links to its original provider, who holds their own rights over the underlying data — this JSON is a convenience mirror of AmazoniaDB's curated list, not a redistribution of provider data.

records.title: GBIF Species Occurrence Data
records.provider: Global Biodiversity Information Facility (GBIF)
records.description: A global aggregator of species occurrence records — museum specimens, citizen-science observations, and survey data — searchable and filterable to the Amazon basin.
records.spatialResolution: Point occurrence records; accuracy varies per record

records.title: speciesLink Network
records.provider: CRIA (Centro de Referência em Informação Ambiental)
records.description: A Brazilian biodiversity data network aggregating occurrence records for plants, animals, fungi, and microorganisms, enriched with images and land-use context for each collection site.
records.spatialResolution: Point occurrence records; accuracy varies per record

records.title: Hidroweb — National Hydrometeorological Network
records.provider: Agência Nacional de Águas e Saneamento Básico (ANA)
records.description: Station-level river level, streamflow, rainfall, and water-quality records from Brazil's National Hydrometeorological Network, run by the federal water agency.
records.temporalCoverage: Varies by station; many series since the early 2000s, some longer

records.title: BDMEP — Historical Meteorological Database
records.provider: Instituto Nacional de Meteorologia (INMET)
records.description: Daily historical weather station records for Brazil since 2000 — temperature, rainfall, humidity, and wind — searchable by station or map.
records.temporalCoverage: Daily records since 2000; series length varies by station

records.title: MapBiomas Land Cover & Use Maps
records.provider: MapBiomas (multi-institutional collaborative network)
records.description: Annual land cover and land-use maps for Brazil since 1985, built from satellite image classification, tracking deforestation, fire, and vegetation change by year and biome.

records.title: TerraBrasilis — PRODES & DETER Deforestation Monitoring
records.provider: Instituto Nacional de Pesquisas Espaciais (INPE)
records.description: Brazil's official satellite-based deforestation monitoring system, publishing annual clear-cut mapping (PRODES) and near-real-time alerts (DETER) for the Legal Amazon and other biomes.
records.temporalCoverage: PRODES annual since 1988; DETER near-real-time alerts
records.spatialResolution: ~30 m (PRODES, Landsat-class); down to ~250 m historically for DETER alerts

records.title: FUNAI Indigenous Territories Geodata
records.provider: Fundação Nacional dos Povos Indígenas (FUNAI)
records.description: Monthly-updated geospatial boundaries for Brazil's indigenous territories, villages, and regional coordination areas, from the federal indigenous affairs agency's mapping unit.
records.spatialResolution: Vector boundaries (polygon/point), not a fixed pixel resolution

records.title: Terras Indígenas no Brasil
records.provider: Instituto Socioambiental (ISA)
records.description: An independent, long-running database profiling Indigenous territories across Brazil — legal status, location, population, and news — maintained by a civil-society organization since the 1980s.

records.title: IBGE Cidades
records.provider: Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE)
records.description: Official municipal and state-level statistics for Brazil — population, economy, education, and health indicators — searchable by place, from the national statistics institute.
records.temporalCoverage: Varies by indicator; many annual, some tied to Census years

records.title: DATASUS TABNET Health Information
records.provider: DATASUS, Ministério da Saúde
records.description: An interactive tabulation tool for Brazil's public health system data — mortality, births, morbidity, and health-facility records — built by the Ministry of Health.
records.temporalCoverage: Varies by sub-system; several series ongoing since the 1990s–2000s

records.title: CNUC — National Register of Conservation Units
records.provider: Ministério do Meio Ambiente e Mudança do Clima (MMA)
records.description: Brazil's national register of conservation units, bringing together federal, state, municipal, and private protected-area records and published boundaries. Registry status and boundaries can lag legal acts; it is not Indigenous territorial or consent data.

records.title: RAISG Amazon Maps
records.provider: Red Amazónica de Información Socioambiental Georreferenciada (RAISG)
records.description: Pan-Amazon geospatial data on indigenous territories, protected natural areas, infrastructure projects, and resource-extraction concessions, compiled by a nine-country civil-society network.
records.temporalCoverage: Periodic updates since 1996; latest full atlas 2020

records.title: Geobosques — National Forest Monitoring Platform
records.provider: Ministerio del Ambiente (MINAM), Programa Nacional de Conservación de Bosques y Clima
records.description: Peru's national forest-loss and early-warning monitoring platform, covering the country's Amazon humid forest with annual loss maps, monthly alerts, and degradation layers.
records.temporalCoverage: Annual forest-loss maps since 2001; near-real-time early-warning alerts
records.spatialResolution: 30 m (Landsat); Sentinel (10 m) used for visual verification

records.title: SAD — Sistema de Alerta de Desmatamento
records.provider: Instituto do Homem e Meio Ambiente da Amazônia (Imazon)
records.description: Independent monthly monitoring of deforestation and forest degradation across the Brazilian Legal Amazon, produced by a non-governmental research institute using Landsat/Sentinel imagery with analyst validation. Runs in parallel to INPE's PRODES/DETER as a cross-check; alert-level data also feeds into Global Forest Watch's open data layers.

records.title: FIRMS — Fire Information for Resource Management System
records.provider: NASA Earth Observing System Data and Information System (EOSDIS)
records.description: Near-real-time active fire and thermal anomaly detections from the MODIS and VIIRS satellite instruments, distributed as point locations with confidence and brightness-temperature attributes. Widely used as an early proxy for both wildfire and agricultural/deforestation burning across the Amazon.

records.title: CHIRPS — Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data
records.provider: Climate Hazards Center, University of California, Santa Barbara
records.description: Quasi-global daily, pentadal, and monthly gridded rainfall estimates blending satellite infrared imagery with in-situ station observations. Built specifically to support drought monitoring and hydrological modeling in data-sparse regions, and in wide use for Amazon basin precipitation trend analysis.

records.title: Wall-to-Wall Amazon Canopy Height Map
records.provider: CTrees, in collaboration with Planet Labs NICFI program
records.description: A ~4.78 m resolution canopy height layer for the entire Amazon biome, generated by training a model on Planet NICFI satellite mosaics using airborne LiDAR as reference data. Intended to support aboveground biomass estimation and forest structure analysis at a finer grain than spaceborne LiDAR alone provides. Access to the underlying Planet NICFI base imagery is governed by Planet's non-commercial program terms.

records.title: Amazon Mining Watch
records.provider: Earth Genome, Pulitzer Center's Rainforest Investigations Network, and Amazon Conservation Association
records.description: A machine-learning-based interactive map of gold-mining scars detected in Sentinel-2 satellite imagery across all nine Amazonian countries, with layered protected-area and Indigenous-territory boundaries (from RAISG) to help distinguish likely authorized from unauthorized activity, plus an economic-impact estimator.

records.title: GEDI — Global Ecosystem Dynamics Investigation
records.provider: University of Maryland / NASA Goddard Space Flight Center
records.description: Spaceborne full-waveform LiDAR mounted on the International Space Station, producing footprint- and gridded-level measurements of canopy height, vertical canopy structure, and aboveground biomass density between 51.6°N and 51.6°S — a band that fully covers the Amazon basin.

records.title: Global Forest Change (Hansen et al.)
records.provider: University of Maryland, Global Land Analysis and Discovery (GLAD) lab
records.description: The standard reference global tree-cover-loss dataset, derived from time-series analysis of the full Landsat archive. Layers include year-2000 tree canopy cover, annual forest loss with year attribution from 2000 onward, and 2000–2012 forest gain, updated approximately annually.

records.title: TerraClass Amazônia
records.provider: Instituto Nacional de Pesquisas Espaciais (INPE) and Embrapa
records.description: Biennial classification of land use and cover specifically within areas already mapped as deforested by PRODES, distinguishing pasture, agriculture, secondary vegetation regrowth, mining, urban infrastructure, and other post-clearing uses across the Brazilian Legal Amazon.

records.title: SiRAD X — Sistema Remoto de Alerta de Desmatamento do Xingu
records.provider: Rede Xingu+ (network coordinated with Instituto Socioambiental and local Indigenous and riverine associations)
records.description: A radar-based deforestation alert system covering the 26.7-million-hectare Xingu Protected Areas Corridor and the Indigenous Lands of the Volta Grande do Xingu, chosen specifically to keep detecting clearings through the cloud cover of the rainy season. Directly relevant to monitoring land-use pressure in the same Volta Grande region affected by the Belo Monte Hydroelectric Complex.

records.title: BDQueimadas — Banco de Dados de Queimadas
records.provider: Instituto Nacional de Pesquisas Espaciais (INPE), Programa Queimadas
records.description: Brazil's official fire and burned-area monitoring system, consolidating heat-source detections from multiple satellites (AQUA, TERRA, NOAA, GOES, NPP-Suomi) since 1998, along with burned-area extent products. Used operationally by IBAMA and state fire agencies, and academically as a long-run fire record.
records.temporalCoverage: 1998–present (near-real-time, updated every 10 minutes to 3 hours depending on product)

records.title: HYBAM — Hydro-geochemistry of the Amazon Basin Observatory
records.provider: Institut de Recherche pour le Développement (IRD), with national partner agencies in Brazil, Peru, Bolivia, Colombia, and Ecuador
records.description: A 17-station international observation network measuring river discharge, sediment load, and water geochemistry across the Amazon basin from the Andean piedmont to the Atlantic outlet, operating continuously since 2003 with standardized cross-border sampling protocols.
records.temporalCoverage: 2003–present (daily/decadal/monthly, depending on variable); some stations reconstructed back to 1902

records.title: Dados Abertos IBAMA — Fiscalização Ambiental
records.provider: Instituto Brasileiro do Meio Ambiente e dos Recursos Naturais Renováveis (IBAMA)
records.description: Brazil's federal environmental enforcement records, including environmental infraction notices (autos de infração) since 2000, embargoed-area geodata, environmental licensing decisions, and related administrative sanctions issued by the federal environmental agency.
records.spatialResolution: Point/parcel-level enforcement records; polygon-level embargoed areas

records.title: HydroSHEDS
records.provider: World Wildlife Fund (WWF) Conservation Science Program, with USGS
records.description: A near-global suite of hydrographic layers — river networks, sub-basin boundaries (HydroBASINS), drainage direction, flow accumulation, and lake outlines — derived primarily from SRTM elevation data, widely used as the geospatial backbone for basin delineation in hydrological studies.

records.title: WorldClim — Global Climate and Weather Data
records.provider: WorldClim (Fick & Hijmans, University of California, Davis / University of Nairobi)
records.description: Interpolated global climate surfaces — monthly temperature, precipitation, solar radiation, wind speed, water vapor pressure, and 19 derived bioclimatic variables — built from weather-station records via thin-plate spline interpolation. A standard baseline layer for species distribution and climate-envelope modeling. The provider's terms do not permit redistribution of the raw data.
records.temporalCoverage: 1970–2000 climatology baseline (historical); future scenario layers also available

records.title: Copernicus DEM (GLO-30)
records.provider: European Space Agency (ESA) / Copernicus Programme
records.description: A global digital surface model at 30 m resolution derived from the TanDEM-X mission, used as a standard terrain layer for hydrological flow-routing, terrain correction of radar imagery, and watershed delineation.

records.title: ESA WorldCover
records.provider: European Space Agency (ESA) WorldCover consortium
records.description: A global 10 m resolution land cover classification derived from Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 imagery, distinguishing 11 land cover classes including tree cover, cropland, built-up area, and open water, with annual composites available from 2020 onward.
records.temporalCoverage: 2020, 2021 baseline maps; annual composites from 2020 onward

records.title: RAINFOR — Amazon Forest Inventory Network
records.provider: University of Leeds, in coordination with partner institutions across Amazonian countries; data managed via ForestPlots.net
records.description: A long-term international network of permanent forest inventory plots spanning the Amazon basin, tracking tree growth, mortality, biomass, and species composition since 2000. Data is compiled and managed through ForestPlots.net under a data-sharing policy that credits the field teams who established and maintain each plot.
records.spatialResolution: Permanent sample plots (typically ~1 ha each) across multiple countries

records.title: PPBio — Programa de Pesquisa em Biodiversidade
records.provider: Instituto Nacional de Pesquisas da Amazônia (INPA) / Ministério da Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação
records.description: A standardized long-term biodiversity monitoring network using the RAPELD sampling design across permanent grid sites in Brazilian ecosystems, with a strong concentration of sites in the Amazon coordinated through INPA. Covers vegetation, fauna, and environmental variables at over 160 sampling grids nationwide.

records.title: Map of Life — Species Range & Distribution Indicators
records.provider: Yale Center for Biodiversity and Global Change
records.description: Expert-vetted global species range maps and annually-updated conservation indicators (Species Habitat Index, Species Protection Index) integrating IUCN Red List, GBIF, and eBird data, harmonized to consistent taxonomies for mammals, birds, reptiles, amphibians, and fishes. Available for individual or batch download for non-commercial use.
records.spatialResolution: Species-level range polygons; configurable by region

records.title: ORA — Observatório Regional Amazônico
records.provider: Organização do Tratado de Cooperação Amazônica (OTCA/ACTO)
records.description: An intergovernmental open-data platform run by the Amazon Cooperation Treaty Organization, integrating over 20 million records from the eight Amazonian member countries on biodiversity, CITES-listed species, water resources, forests, fire, and indigenous peoples into shared dashboards and geographic viewers.
records.temporalCoverage: Varies by module; fire module covers 2001–2025
records.spatialResolution: Varies by module; national to basin-wide

records.title: LandMark — Global Platform of Indigenous and Community Lands
records.provider: World Resources Institute, in coalition with 12+ land rights organizations
records.description: An interactive global map of collectively-held Indigenous and community lands, layering legal recognition status, tenure security indicators, and pressures such as deforestation, dams, and resource concessions. Consolidates contributions from regional and national land-rights organizations rather than independently drawing boundaries.

records.title: RRI Tenure Tool — Forest, Land & Resource Tenure Tracking
records.provider: Rights and Resources Initiative (RRI)
records.description: Longitudinal databases tracking legal recognition of forest, land, and water tenure rights for Indigenous Peoples, Afro-descendant Peoples, and local communities across more than 75 countries, covering roughly 92% of global forest area, continuously updated and verified by a network of national experts.

records.title: EcoCrime Data — Amazon Environmental Crime Platform
records.provider: Instituto Igarapé
records.description: An interactive data visualization platform tracking environmental crime across all nine Amazonian countries — illegal logging, land grabbing, wildcat mining, and wildlife trafficking — combining open-source data with narrative stories produced in partnership with InSight Crime and other investigative partners.

records.title: Povos Indígenas no Brasil (PIB)
records.provider: Instituto Socioambiental (ISA)
records.description: A continuously updated encyclopedia documenting the ways of life, languages, history, and rights of Brazil's 266+ Indigenous peoples, maintained by ISA since the early 1980s alongside a periodic flagship print edition. Distinct from ISA's territorial boundary geodata already in this catalog, PIB focuses on the peoples and cultures themselves.

records.title: Censo Demográfico 2022 — Povos Indígenas
records.provider: Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE)
records.description: Official census results specific to Indigenous peoples, covering 391 ethnicities and 295 languages with demographic, territorial, and socioeconomic breakdowns by municipality, Indigenous Land, and Legal Amazon subregion, accessible through IBGE's SIDRA and Interactive Geographic Platform.
records.temporalCoverage: Systematic collection since 1991; latest round 2022, with continued table releases
records.spatialResolution: Municipality, Indigenous Land, Legal Amazon subregion

records.title: Glottolog — Catalogue of the World's Languages
records.provider: Max Planck Institute for Evolutionary Anthropology
records.description: An open-access bibliographic and genealogical catalogue of the world's languages, including detailed classification and reference data for every documented Amazonian Indigenous language, built as a transparent, non-paywalled alternative to proprietary language databases.

records.title: Observatório da Violência contra os Povos Indígenas no Brasil
records.provider: Conselho Indigenista Missionário (Cimi)
records.description: An annual report, published since 1996, systematizing data on violence and rights violations against Indigenous peoples in Brazil across territorial, personal, and public-omission categories, sourced from Cimi's regional networks, freedom-of-information requests, and public health surveillance systems.
records.spatialResolution: Case-level, aggregated nationally and by state

records.title: Comunidades Quilombolas Certificadas
records.provider: Fundação Cultural Palmares
records.description: The official national registry of certified remnant quilombo communities (Afro-descendant traditional communities), issued through a self-declaration process under ILO Convention 169, with continuous certification since 2003. A meaningful share of Brazil's quilombola territories are in the Amazon states of Pará, Maranhão, and Tocantins.

records.title: Atlas do Desenvolvimento Humano no Brasil
records.provider: PNUD Brasil, Ipea, and Fundação João Pinheiro
records.description: A joint UNDP/IPEA/FJP platform providing the Municipal Human Development Index (IDHM) and over 200 socioeconomic indicators — population, education, housing, income, and vulnerability — for all 5,565 Brazilian municipalities, running since 1997 with a subset of indicators updated annually from administrative records.

records.title: PNAD Contínua — Pesquisa Nacional por Amostra de Domicílios Contínua
records.provider: Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE)
records.description: Brazil's ongoing quarterly household sample survey, providing detailed public microdata on employment, income, education, housing, and food security, disaggregatable to state and regional level including the Legal Amazon states.

records.title: Cadastro Único para Programas Sociais (CadÚnico)
records.provider: Ministério do Desenvolvimento e Assistência Social, Família e Combate à Fome (MDS)
records.description: Aggregate statistics on low-income families registered in Brazil's unified social-program registry, updated daily and used to target federal, state, and municipal social assistance programs, providing a fine-grained proxy for social vulnerability by municipality.

records.title: VIGISAN — Inquérito Nacional sobre Insegurança Alimentar
records.provider: Rede Brasileira de Pesquisa em Soberania e Segurança Alimentar e Nutricional (Rede PENSSAN)
records.description: A national household survey series measuring food insecurity using the Brazilian Food Insecurity Scale, run by an academic research network since 2020 with state-level breakdowns, filling gaps left when official food-security data collection was interrupted.

records.title: MapBiomas Amazonia Land Cover & Water
records.provider: MapBiomas Amazonia (RAISG network)
records.description: Pan-Amazon annual land-cover and land-use maps built from Landsat imagery and a common regional legend. The project also publishes separate monthly and annual surface-water products.
records.temporalCoverage: 1985–2023 (annual land cover); separate monthly/annual water products

records.title: JRC Global Surface Water
records.provider: European Commission, Joint Research Centre (JRC)
records.description: Global Landsat-derived maps of surface-water occurrence, change, seasonality, recurrence, and transitions, which can be subset to the Amazon.

records.title: SIGA — Electricity Generation Information System
records.provider: Agência Nacional de Energia Elétrica (ANEEL)
records.description: Official register of Brazilian electricity-generating enterprises with coordinates, source, operating status, capacity, municipality, and sub-basin. A facility record does not establish social or ecological impact.
records.license: Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL)

records.title: SEEG — Greenhouse Gas Emissions Estimates
records.provider: Sistema de Estimativas de Emissões e Remoções de Gases de Efeito Estufa (SEEG)
records.description: Annual estimates of Brazil's greenhouse-gas emissions and removals, available by sector and, for several sectors, state and municipality. These are modeled estimates, not direct local measurements.

records.title: SIGMINE — Mining Process Registry
records.provider: Agência Nacional de Mineração (ANM)
records.description: Official registry of Brazilian mining-process polygons, status, and administrative data. A process boundary is informational, not proof of active extraction, legal authorization, or illegality.
